title: The Young Cupbearer
author: James Baldwin
summary: 小居鲁士宁可把宴席上的美食分给朋友，也不铺张浪费。
publicDomainBasis: Published 1912 by the American Book Company; author James Baldwin (1841–1925). Public domain in the United States and in China (author's life plus 70 years).

paragraphs.en: Long, long ago, there lived in Persia a little prince whose name was Cyrus.
paragraphs.zh: 很久很久以前，波斯住着一位小王子，名叫居鲁士。

paragraphs.en: He was not petted and spoiled like many other princes. Although his father was a king, Cyrus was brought up like the son of a common man.
paragraphs.zh: 他并不像许多其他王子那样被娇惯坏。虽然父亲是国王，居鲁士却像普通人家的孩子一样长大。

paragraphs.en: He knew how to work with his hands. He ate only the plainest food. He slept on a hard bed. He learned to endure hunger and cold.
paragraphs.zh: 他懂得动手干活。他只吃最普通的食物，睡硬板床，学会了忍受饥饿和寒冷。

paragraphs.en: When Cyrus was twelve years old he went with his mother to Media to visit his grandfather. His grandfather, whose name was Astyages, was king of Media, and very rich and powerful.
paragraphs.zh: 居鲁士十二岁时，随母亲去米底探望外祖父。外祖父名叫阿斯提阿格斯，是米底国王，非常富有、有权势。

paragraphs.en: Cyrus was so tall and strong and handsome that his grandfather was very proud of him. He wished the lad to stay with him in Media. He therefore gave him many beautiful gifts and everything that could please a prince. One day King Astyages planned to make a great feast for the lad. The tables were to be laden with all kinds of food. There was to be music and dancing; and Cyrus was to invite as many guests as he chose. The hour for the feast came. Everything was ready. The servants were there, dressed in fine uniforms. The musicians and dancers were in their places. But no guests came.
paragraphs.zh: 居鲁士又高又壮，相貌英俊，外祖父为他感到非常骄傲。他希望这孩子留在米底，于是送给他许多精美的礼物和一切能让王子开心的东西。一天，阿斯提阿格斯国王打算为孩子举办一场盛大的宴会。桌上要摆满各种食物，还有音乐和舞蹈；居鲁士想请多少客人就请多少。宴会的时间到了，一切准备就绪。仆人们穿着漂亮的制服站在那里，乐师和舞者也各就各位，可是一个客人也没来。

paragraphs.en: "How is this, my dear boy?" asked the king. "The feast is ready, but no one has come to partake of it."
paragraphs.zh: “这是怎么回事，我亲爱的孩子？”国王问，“宴会准备好了，却没有人来赴宴。”

paragraphs.en: "That is because I have not invited any one," said Cyrus." In Persia we do not have such feasts. If any one is hungry, he eats some bread and meat, with perhaps a few cresses, and that is the end of it. We never go to all this trouble and expense of making a fine dinner in order that our friends may eat what is not good for them."
paragraphs.zh: “那是因为我谁也没请，”居鲁士说，“在波斯，我们不会举办这样的宴会。谁要是饿了，就吃点面包和肉，也许再加几根水芹，这就够了。我们绝不会费这么多事、花这么多钱做一桌丰盛的饭菜，就为了让朋友们吃那些对他们身体不好的东西。”

paragraphs.en: King Astyages did not know whether to be pleased or displeased.
paragraphs.zh: 阿斯提阿格斯国王不知道自己是该高兴还是该不高兴。

paragraphs.en: "Well," said he, "all these rich foods that were prepared for the feast are yours. What will you do with them?"
paragraphs.zh: “好吧，”他说，“为宴会准备的所有这些美味佳肴都归你了。你打算怎么处理？”

paragraphs.en: "I think I will give them to our friends," said Cyrus.
paragraphs.zh: “我想我会把它们分给我们的朋友。”居鲁士说。

paragraphs.en: So he gave one portion to the king's officer who had taught him to ride. Another portion he gave to an old servant who waited upon his grandfather. And the rest he divided among the young women who took care of his mother.
paragraphs.zh: 于是他把一份送给教他骑马的国王侍从，另一份送给服侍外祖父的老仆人，剩下的分给了照顾母亲的年轻侍女们。
